question: The product of the three consecutive odd numbers is 1287. What is the sum of the largest and the smallest of the three numbers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Approximate the **cube root** of the product: √³1287 ≈ 10.87.

The **consecutive odd numbers** near 10.87 are 9, 11, and 13.

Check: 9 × 11 × 13 = 1287 (Matches given product).

Sum of **largest** (13) and **smallest** (9) = 9 + 13 = 22.

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Product of **three consecutive odd numbers** = 1287.

**Formula Used:** Product of terms = (x − 2) × x × (x + 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1c4cc9c8ea2b0796c3907337c68a82e89378a71506d5c42f7ca3c336172c06.png] 

⇒ Let the numbers be (x − 2), x, and (x + 2).

⇒ (x − 2) × x × (x + 2) = 1287

⇒ x(x² − 4) = 1287

⇒ Factorizing 1287: 1287 = 3 × 3 × 11 × 13 = 9 × 11 × 13

⇒ By comparison, x = 11.

⇒ Smallest number = 11 − 2 = 9

⇒ Largest number = 11 + 2 = 13

⇒ Sum = 9 + 13 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Odd/Even Numbers

The difference between any two **consecutive odd** or **consecutive even** numbers is always 2.

Cube Root Estimation

For the product of three consecutive integers (n−1), n, (n+1), the product is approximately n³. This helps in quickly identifying the **middle term**.

Arithmetic Progression (AP)

Consecutive odd numbers form an **Arithmetic Progression** with common difference d = 2. The sum of n terms is Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n−1)d].
